name: Silt Reeve
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
abilities.description: While the reeve is moving toward a creature it has damaged within the last 24 hours, the reeve's Speed can't be reduced and Difficult Terrain doesn't cost it extra movement.

abilities.name: Umbral Step (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the reeve takes the Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The reeve makes three attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Gravewax Mark.

actions.name: Gravewax Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Gravewax Mark
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target is restrained until the end of its next turn.

generation.userConcept: a reeve of the drowned marsh who never loses a trail

clauses.text: a reeve of the drowned marsh

generation.cite: composition after Assassin (CR 8) — the rider-heavy burst and the expertise Stealth

other_edition.lore: A reeve drowned while chasing a fleeing debtor across the marsh, and the fen kept the office rather than the man; it rises wherever a trail goes cold and claims anything that strays from where it began.
